units.source_text: 他想就此走脱，转念这未免太冷酷了，便走进门去。

en.t: He thought of slipping away just like that, but then reconsidered, feeling it would be too cold-hearted, and went in through the gate.

units.source_text: 对手是个老女，因此两人搭讪不免稍轻薄些，但也觉得别有异趣。

en.t: Since the other person was an old woman, their banter was inevitably somewhat frivolous, yet it also had a peculiar charm of its own.
